definitions.explanation: A section or division of an organization.
An extracurricular activity club at school.

examples.japanese: ⟦{営業部|えいぎょうぶ}→営業部：noentry⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{配属|はいぞく}された→配属：06159_haizoku⟧。
examples.english: I was assigned to the sales department.

examples.japanese: ⟦{野球部|やきゅうぶ}→野球部：noentry⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
⟦{上半身|じょうはんしん}→上半身：11509_jouhanshin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{胸部|きょうぶ}→胸部：noentry⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧。
{総務部|そうむぶ}に{問|と}い{合|あ}わせた。
examples.english: I contacted the general affairs department.

examples.japanese: {開発部|かいはつぶ}で{新製品|しんせいひん}を{設計|せっけい}している。
examples.english: We are designing new products in the development department.

examples.japanese: {美術部|びじゅつぶ}で{絵|え}を{描|か}いている。
examples.english: I paint in the art club.

examples.japanese: {高校|こうこう}のとき{吹奏楽部|すいそうがくぶ}に{入|はい}っていた。
examples.english: I was in the wind ensemble club in high school.

examples.japanese: {前半部|ぜんはんぶ}はおもしろかったが、{後半部|こうはんぶ}は{退屈|たいくつ}だった。
examples.english: The first part was interesting, but the latter part was boring.

examples.japanese: {本|ほん}の{第三部|だいさんぶ}から{読|よ}み{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: I started reading from part three of the book.

notes:
〜{部|ぶ} is a suffix meaning 'department,' 'club,' or 'part.'

MEANING 1 - COMPANY DEPARTMENT:
- {営業部|えいぎょうぶ}: sales department
- {総務部|そうむぶ}: general affairs department
- {人事部|じんじぶ}: human resources department
- {開発部|かいはつぶ}: development department

MEANING 2 - SCHOOL CLUB:
- {野球部|やきゅうぶ}: baseball club
- {吹奏楽部|すいそうがくぶ}: brass band club
- {文芸部|ぶんげいぶ}: literary club
- {部活|ぶかつ}: club activities

MEANING 3 - BODY PART/SECTION:
- {胸部|きょうぶ}: chest area
- {腹部|ふくぶ}: abdominal area
- {上部|じょうぶ}: upper part
- {下部|かぶ}: lower part
